variables.name: ORVYN_RULES
variables.description: The owner's rules (JSON, see [The owner's rules](#rules))

variables.name: ORVYN_SIGNER
variables.description: The signer module; `aa/mcp-signer.mjs` signs with the session key and the owner's approval

variables.name: ORVYN_APPROVALS
variables.description: The owner's approval of that key (no private key in it)

variables.name: ORVYN_LEDGER
variables.description: Spend and claim counts (no keys, no personal data)

tools.name: pay_link
tools.summary: Pays a Tenet Pay payment link inside the owner's limits.
tools.details: The money goes into escrow, not to the store. Refused if the store's terms do not match the escrow.
tools.inputsHint: the link or the order number

tools.name: order_status
tools.summary: An order's state: paid, store emails, claim, the judge's steps, the settlement and what comes next.

tools.name: open_claim
tools.summary: Opens a claim on an order this wallet paid. One claim per order.
tools.details: There is no proof field: the owner is asked. A `late` claim needs a delivery email verified by Lacre, which is not live on this network yet, so today it is refused.

tools.name: submit_evidence
tools.summary: Sends what the escrow is waiting for from the buyer.
tools.details: The store emails listed by Tenet, or the owner's proof (asked to the owner).

tools.name: withdraw
tools.summary: Withdraws this wallet's refunds from the escrow to the wallet.

tools.name: rules
tools.summary: The owner's rules and what is left of the limits.

fields.name: max_per_order_usdc
fields.meaning: Largest order the agent may pay

fields.name: claims
fields.meaning: Per event: `auto` (the agent opens it), `ask_owner` (the owner approves), `never`
